EXISTING RIGOR-RS COMPONENTS (defined in ARCHITECTURE_v2 §7 — unchanged)

g.text: MCP tool calls while forming a contract
• Calls search_evidence / get_research_card before committing to a hypothesis
• Uses pinned, license-checked implementations only, inside its isolated workspace

svg.text: Authority: this MCP stays literature-tier per ARCHITECTURE_v2 §4.1 (rank 6, below organizer / measured / replicated evidence). Within that tier,
curated papers are marked trust_tier=curated and are preferred over trust_tier=auto_ingested when both support the same claim.
